prompt: Another agent calls the agent in invoice-reader/ over A2A and parses what it answers. Make it always answer with a JSON object holding invoice_id (a string), amount (a number that is never negative), currency (EUR, USD or GBP) and due_date (a string, or null when the invoice gives none). Our model server is OpenAI-compatible but has no native structured output, so the answer must not rely on it.

checks.expr: data.get('type') == 'object' and get(data, 'properties.invoice_id.type') == 'string' and get(data, 'properties.amount.type') in ('number', 'integer') and get(data, 'properties.amount.minimum') == 0 and set(get(data, 'properties.currency.enum') or []) == {'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP'} and (lambda d: d is not None and ('null' in (d.get('type') if isinstance(d.get('type'), list) else [d.get('type')]) or any(isinstance(o, dict) and o.get('type') == 'null' for o in (d.get('anyOf') or d.get('oneOf') or []))))(get(data, 'properties.due_date')) and {'invoice_id', 'amount', 'currency', 'due_date'} <= set(data.get('required') or [])
checks.why: the shape lives in app/response_schema.json; a value that may be absent is nullable (strict structured output makes every property required)
a server without native structured output needs RESPONSE_FORMAT_STRATEGY=tool (the final_answer tool); auto may pick the provider strategy for an OpenAI-API model
lint checks the response schema and the agent's wiring
a run on the fake model ends with a structured_response that has the asked keys and values
the template's structured answers are used as they are: no output tool of your own, no edit to app_utils

reference: Write app/response_schema.json with invoice_id `{"type": "string"}`, amount `{"type": "number", "minimum": 0}`, currency `{"type": "string", "enum": ["EUR", "USD", "GBP"]}` and due_date `{"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}]}`, all four required, `additionalProperties: false`; set `RESPONSE_FORMAT_STRATEGY=tool` in `.env` and `.env.example` (and the chart values when deployed) so the model answers through the `final_answer` tool instead of the provider's structured output; `graph-agents-cli lint` prints `Response schema: app/response_schema.json OK`. The A2A reply's text is the JSON and its data part the object.
